text:
emma (People Ops): Quick cross-region note: managers in EMEA/APAC, there are a few policy nuances this cycle (parental leave, payroll blackout, and local bank holidays). Pls read before finalizing manager notes.
hana (EM EMEA): thanks. can we get a short checklist for employees who were on parental leave during review window? how do we annotate expectations?
li (People Ops): Short answer: mark the "leave_adjusted" flag in the tracker and add LOE (length of exclusion) in the evidence doc. Use three-line rationale: dates, adjusted goals, and supporting outcomes.
raj (EM APAC): for APAC folks: some local public holidays fall inside signoff week. are there auto-extensions for OOO managers?
emma (People Ops): We have a standard 48h extension policy for documented regional holidays that impact >30% of a manager's direct reports. Request via the review-exceptions form with the holiday date and impact note.
karl (Payroll): FYI payroll blackout: comp changes cannot be applied between 2024-06-28 and 2024-07-05 due to payroll close. If your team needs immediate comp adjustments for promotions, flag them early so comp ops can prioritize.
leave-bot: Reminder: parental-leave flag template: https://intra/redwood/people-ops/leave-annotation-template (auto-fill CSV available).
hana (EM EMEA): For part-year parents (returned 2024-03-01), do we normalize to FTE or judge on active months?
li (People Ops): Judge on active months; include contribution fraction e.g., "0.6 FTE Jan-Mar". Managers should avoid blanket "no promotion" statements — present evidence & the ask. Calibration will consider time on the job.
raj (EM APAC): Is there a specific way to handle raise effective dates with payroll blackout? Managers want promos effective before fiscal quarter end.
karl (Payroll): If promotion must be effective before blackout, submit comp requests by 2024-06-20 EOD with supporting docs. We can only process exceptions with Director approval and headcount confirmation.
emma (People Ops): Another region item: EMEA legal requires we not include salary history in the manager packet for candidates in certain countries — stick to level/ask only. Legal will scrub packets flagged with country codes.
hana (EM EMEA): thanks — we'll tag affected rows with "emea_privacy".
li (People Ops): Quick data tip: to export all team rows with leave flags run: 
```
jq -r '.[] | select(.leave_adjusted=="true") | .email' tracker_export.json
```
Copy-paste safe.
raj (EM APAC): For timezone-friendly calibration slots: can we request an evening APAC-friendly panel? We had pushback last cycle.
emma (People Ops): Yes, reserve "regional" slots labeled "APAC-friendly"; chairs are asked to accept one evening session per week during calibration. Signups are first-come.
leave-bot: Action required: LOA documentation deadline = 2024-06-10 17:00 PT. Missing docs will default to standard timelines and may not get adjusted expectations.
karl (Payroll): One more payroll note: stock/equity changes are handled in a separate cycle and will not be reflected until after our comp pass; communicate to ICs accordingly.
hana (EM EMEA): Appeals flow for leave-adjusted cases? IC wants to know if they can contest adjusted expectations.
li (People Ops): Appeals timeline unchanged: managers have 72h to submit post-calibration evidence. IC appeals run through manager -> calibration chair -> people-ops. For leave cases we may request HRIS verification.
raj (EM APAC): If a manager is out and their skip-level needs to sign off, does People Ops facilitate alternate signoff?
emma (People Ops): Yes use the proxy reviewer form; People Ops will update the signoff flow and cc the skip-level. Include reason & duration.
li (People Ops): Final note: we've added two new report columns: "leave_adjusted" and "payroll_blackout_risk". Use them sparingly and only when the payroll or legal teams are impacted.
karl (Payroll): If anyone needs a prioritized export for comp planning, DM me and we'll push a CSV.
hana (EM EMEA): thanks team. will update our tracker and ping for the LOA list.
emma (People Ops): thanks all 44d we'll post a one-page "International signoff cheat sheet" to the checklist page by noon.
